content:
{'translated': 'The comedy *Stick*, starring Owen Wilson, has plenty in common with *Ted Lasso* — and Apple has just announced the second season will be dropping soon, with *Pluribus* actress Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.'}

{'translated': '*Stick* season two premieres November 4, with Rhea Seehorn joining the cast'}

{'translated': 'After the season three finale of *Ted Lasso* aired, nobody knew if the show would ever come back. Luckily, *Lasso* fans got their wish, and season four is currently airing.'}

{'translated': 'But in its absence, Apple TV has launched a new show that shares a lot of DNA with *Lasso*.'}

{'translated': '*Stick*, starring Owen Wilson, premiered last summer and was immediately compared to *Ted Lasso*, with people calling it another heartwarming sports comedy. Now, with *Lasso* season four just wrapped, *Stick* is also returning.'}

{'translated': '*Stick* season two premieres November 4 (Wednesday) with its first two episodes, followed by one episode per week through December 30.'}

{'translated': "Here's the spoiler-free synopsis provided by Apple:"}

{'translated': "According to Apple's press release, season two will see Santi pursuing the next step in his professional golf career, while Pryce also returns to the sport."}

{'translated': "*Stick*'s strong ensemble will all be back for season two — beyond Wilson, the cast includes Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant."}

{'translated': "*Pluribus* actress Rhea Seehorn joins the show as Pryce's new golf coach. New cast members also include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle."}

{'translated': 'You can watch season one of *Stick* on Apple TV.'}

{'translated': 'Are you a fan of *Stick*? Planning to watch season two? Drop us a note in the comments.'}

{'translated': 'Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can bundle it for a discount through Apple One.'}
